title: SynEthica: Agentic Responsible AI Data Generator
summary: SynEthica is a LangGraph-based agentic pipeline that generates privacy-safe, bias-mitigated synthetic tabular data by looping generation and validation agents with fairness (AIF360) and privacy checks. Its generator agent trains an SDV CTGANSynthesizer on input data with conditional sampling, and its QA agent evaluates output fidelity using SDV's evaluate_quality function.
